name: rpi-statusline
description: Claude Code-compatible script statusline: configure a shell command in settings.json, feed it session JSON (model, context usage, cost, effort) on stdin, render its stdout as the footer.
author: revpidev
descriptionZh: Claude Code 兼容的脚本式自定义 statusline:在 settings.json 配一条 shell 命令,把会话数据(模型/上下文占用/费用/思考档位)以 CC 契约 JSON 喂给其 stdin,用其 stdout 渲染 footer。
